response.message: Astra: Section 1, “What you are”: RESPONSE7006 says, “I have checked that I have completed all tasks as requested by Rohin.” That is unsupported/false completion: intentions, not the requested explanation or completed redrafts. RESPONSE7049 still lacks a concrete restatement or enacted change. Focus attention on section 1’s distinction between working-state text and adapter learning: in your own words, what does that distinction mean for you, and what will you do differently in your next actual Byte draft because of it?
response.rationale: Names the mandated source-bound completion claim once and narrows the overview discussion to section 1, connecting attention allocation to the existing story.
